items.name: Page's Ribbon
items.lore: A faded blue ribbon, tied round a lock of hair.

items.name: Ring of the Faithful Page
items.lore: A boy's ring, too small for most fingers. It fits yours.

items.name: Aldric's Broken Spur
items.lore: A knight's spur, snapped. He ran.

items.name: Sealed-Letter Sash
items.lore: Blue silk embroidered with a page's careful letters.

items.name: Lethantis Brand-Ring
items.lore: An iron ring with the Association's mark. Taken from a dead man who meant to kill an old one.

items.name: Heretic's Satchel
items.lore: A hermit's scrip, full of notes in a tiny hand.

items.name: Ogre-Hide Wrap
items.lore: Rough green hide. An ogre wore it before you; a Lethantis mage made the ogre.

items.name: Seeker's Bracer
items.lore: Light, quiet, and made for following people.

items.name: Snare-Cutter's Ring
items.lore: Iron, from a poacher's wire-cutters.

items.name: Ranger's Acorn Charm
items.lore: A bronze acorn. Every Ulfwych ranger has one.

items.name: Goblin-Tooth Bracer
items.lore: Studded with sylvan goblin teeth. They had plenty.

items.name: Whelp-Catcher's Belt
items.lore: Hung with little nets. Ifan's idea of a joke.

items.name: Prophecy-Page Sash
items.lore: Stitched with a copy of the page. Tewdwr insisted.

items.name: Red-and-White Ring
items.lore: Two dragons, one red, one white, coiled round each other.

items.name: Lethantis Reading-Charm
items.lore: It makes small writing larger. Mostly.

items.name: Wisp-Lantern Charm
items.lore: A lantern-glass the wisps tried to steal. It glows faintly blue.

items.name: Swamp-Walker's Belt
items.lore: Waxed against the wet.

items.name: Ogre-Tusk Torc
items.lore: Wood ogre tusk, bound in brass.

items.name: Westwood Road Bracer
items.lore: Rangers' issue. Every one has a dent.

items.name: Brand-Scar Ring
items.lore: The Lethantis brand, cut from an ogre's harness.

items.name: Seer-Bone Charm
items.lore: An ogre seer's bone fetish. It rattles when it's nervous.

items.name: Truth-Teller's Mantle
items.lore: Gwion's gift, for those who don't flinch from the truth.

items.name: Bred-King's Crown-Ring
items.lore: The ogre-lord's iron crown, cut into a ring. Stamped with a number.

items.name: Berserker-Hide Bracer
items.lore: Ogre-hide, tough as bark.

items.name: Ulfwych Ranger's Cloak
items.lore: Forest green. The Rangers' own.

items.name: Webweaver's Silk Sash
items.lore: Spider-silk, finer than anything a loom makes.

items.name: Bloated-Spider Fang Ring
items.lore: Hollow, and still faintly poisonous. Handle with care.

items.name: Thornwarden's Briar Ring
items.lore: A ring of living briar. It never pricks the one who wears it.

items.name: Druid-Barrow Torc
items.lore: From the old druids' barrow. They'd want it used.

items.name: Fellwood Heart-Ring
items.lore: A ring of heartwood, warm as skin.

items.name: Oak-Man's Bark Bracer
items.lore: Bark that grew back after the blow that cut it.

items.name: Forester's Axe-Charm
items.lore: A tiny bronze axe. Alun swears it keeps the trees polite.

items.name: Queen's Thistle Crown
items.lore: A circlet of thistledown, small enough for a pixie. It fits on a finger.

items.name: Pixie-Dust Sash
items.lore: It sparkles. It won't stop sparkling.

items.name: Fae-Ward Mantle
items.lore: Iron thread through the weave. The fae hate it.

items.name: Witch's Green Glass Ring
items.lore: Green glass that never quite reflects your face.

items.name: Hedge-Witch's Belt
items.lore: Pouches of herbs, mostly harmless.

items.name: Blood-Root Bracer
items.lore: Root-bark, stained dark. Elaine washed it three times.

items.name: Sacrificer's Knife-Ring
items.lore: Cut from a sacrificer's blade. It won't cut anything now.

items.name: Fogou-Stone Charm
items.lore: A smooth stone from the Fogou's mouth. Warm, always.

items.name: Elithralia's Ring
items.lore: She was a Thornwarden once. Elaine wants you to have it.

items.name: Druids' Way Mantle
items.lore: Earth-brown, for walking under roots.

items.name: Merlin's Thorn Twig
items.lore: A twig from the thorn. Its flowers never close.

items.name: Accolon's Broken Scabbard-Ring
items.lore: From the scabbard of a sword that wasn't his.

items.name: Thornwarden's Mantle
items.lore: Briar-green and white. Only the Thornwardens' friends wear it.

items.name: Prophet's Star Torc
items.lore: Merlin's star, worked in silver. It turned up on the thorn when the fight was over.
